**[Download Windows installer](https://github.com/peachyGT/armored-core-hub/releases/latest/download/ArmoredCoreHub-Setup-win-x64.exe)** · **[Download portable ZIP](https://github.com/peachyGT/armored-core-hub/releases/latest/download/ArmoredCoreHub-win-x64.zip)**

Windows 10/11 x64. No separate .NET installation needed.

1. Choose the installer, open it and click **Install**. Or extract the entire portable ZIP and open `ArmoredCoreHub.exe`.
2. Open the Hub, choose **Add games** and select your game folder.
3. Follow the selected game's setup checklist, then click **Play**.

Updating? Close the Hub and games first. Run the installer over the installed copy, or back up your portable folder before replacing application files. Personal Hub data is retained. Installed and portable copies remain separate.

The downloads are unsigned; Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Check the supplied SHA-256 file if needed. GitHub's automatically generated **Source code** archives are for development; use one of the app downloads above.
